title: Stage Casting × Performable Music — 16 high-return visual studies
purpose: Create 16 short 15–30s independent audiovisual/coding proofs based on one shared runtime and author-owned assets. Only top 4 graduate into show pieces; NOT 16 new DAWs or 16 final 4-minute tracks.
scoring: Planning-only heuristic: show relevance 30%, reusable implementation 25%, probability of tangible export 25%, distinctive authorship 10%, dependency readiness 10%. Score is an editorial priority estimate, not success probability.
timebox: Single concept typically 90 minutes; two sessions maximum unless selected at a Gate. Output at least playable mp4/web demo + versioned source + failure note.
quality_bars: Author-provided material and framing stay sovereign
Audio should still be meaningful when the screen is off
One shared Show Score event for audio+visual for promoted candidates
Export at 16:45 QA block; user audition is required
No payware, no fabricated software/hardware tests
Protect Dec 3 P0 music work over P1 visual volume

studies.name: 同一事件驱动声音与视觉
studies.required_input: 一份真实声源与 Show Score 接口
studies.acceptance: 一次 FOOT/按钮事件同时改变真实声音、3D 与文字，三端事件 ID 一致
studies.minimum_reusable_deliverable: 共享事件适配器+60s视频+日志
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: 作者素材混合器
studies.required_input: 一张你自己选择的图片/5s视频
studies.acceptance: 同一素材三种构图且不裁画幅，镜头不自动推拉
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: OVERRIDE 身体触发
studies.acceptance: 手动触发撤除→回归，可单键撤销，有触发日志
studies.minimum_reusable_deliverable: Cue触发器+状态录像+安全回退
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: 录制重放与故障恢复
studies.acceptance: 同一 JSON 记录两次重放的章节与事件序列一致；断线回中性
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: 舞台字体与信息图形
studies.acceptance: 两种清晰可读的排版模式，文字不是调试参数墙
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: Geometry Nodes → glTF
studies.required_input: 一件本人原创 GN 资产，或新建极简测试几何
studies.acceptance: Blender 求值模型与网页画幅保真，实际加载 GLB，不伪称节点逻辑移植
studies.minimum_reusable_deliverable: 资产出口/加载器+素材验收记录
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: 可控曲线与轨道
studies.required_input: 当前 V0.2 内建 ORBITS
studies.acceptance: 固定镜头下三种形态，由参数或事件决定而非自动乱动
studies.minimum_reusable_deliverable: 曲线模块+预设+对比录像
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: 原创影像/素材叠加
studies.acceptance: 一段原创视频与实时图层有明确前后景，转场可手动触发
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: Drop Flow 动作轨迹再利用
studies.required_input: 本人可使用的动补/轨迹数据，来源核对
studies.acceptance: 至少一条真实人体轨迹映射到粒子/线条，保留素材来源
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: 点云/发射器混合
studies.required_input: 真实点云或原创粒子源；V05
studies.acceptance: 有来源的运动/扫描影响粒子生成，与随机噪声可区分
studies.minimum_reusable_deliverable: 粒子组件+运动对照录像
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: 音乐期待的视觉缺口
studies.required_input: Composition Plan 011 或音乐事件日志；V13
studies.acceptance: 第17小节缺失的事件在画面留下可辨认空位，第25小节归来
studies.minimum_reusable_deliverable: 带时间码的 A/B 场景+共享 Cue
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: 双时钟/复节奏视觉化
studies.acceptance: 两个有差异的节奏周期相遇时音画确实同时对齐
studies.minimum_reusable_deliverable: 两个时钟场景+时钟一致性日志
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: 音色驱动结构断裂
studies.acceptance: 一件作者定义的空间形体在音乐事件上裂变/复位，摄像机不自动缩放
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: 显式镜头 Cue
studies.acceptance: 镜头必须手动触发；HOLD、CUT、MOVE 可复现
studies.minimum_reusable_deliverable: 镜头状态机+两个A/B镜头方案
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: 空间工作站/演奏 UI
studies.required_input: V09，已有 ENTROPY 界面语言
studies.acceptance: 演奏者工具 UI 与主屏画面分离，屏幕可不展示调试数据
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.

studies.name: 空间音频轨迹映射
studies.required_input: V13，实际音频输出/声道布局
studies.acceptance: 先双声道定位/动态深度；多声道必须真实测过才能升级
studies.notes: Human must audition visual and music separately. No claim of stage readiness without runtime verification.
